title: Franco Gomez - Backend Developer
name: Franco Gomez
contact: Backend Software Developer | Buenos Aires, Argentina | frangomez0566@gmail.com | English: C1 Advanced
about: Backend Software Developer specializing in building high-performance distributed systems and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Quarkus, and Cloud-native technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, VMware Tanzu). Experienced in high-throughput enterprise environments across healthcare and IT consulting, with proven success in modernizing legacy PHP monoliths into decoupled architectures with Quarkus and React. Focused on code quality, observability, and solving complex technical challenges. Open to international roles and remote engineering opportunities.
experience_osde_description: Development and architecture of critical microservices for OSDE's healthcare ecosystem using Java, Spring Boot, and Quarkus. Led the migration and modernization of a legacy PHP monolithic system into a decoupled distributed architecture (Java/Quarkus Backend + React Frontend). Operated containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes via Lens) deployed on VMware Tanzu, ensuring high availability, observability via logs/dashboards, and security standards for high-volume transactions.
experience_softtek1_description: Backend development using Java, Spring Boot, and MySQL for a turnkey corporate project. Responsible for implementing complex business logic from functional specifications, optimizing database queries, structuring API requests with Postman, and building secure, testable REST endpoints under Clean Code principles.
experience_softtek2_description: Advanced backend support and maintenance for production healthcare applications. Analyzed logs and resolved live performance incidents in real time, delivered hotfixes in production environments, and developed continuous enhancements to ensure strict compliance with service SLAs.
experience_softtek3_description: Intensive hands-on training program focused on Java architecture, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, Docker, and design patterns. Designed, built, and deployed an end-to-end web application from REST API design to frontend integration.
